The '''Vesari system''' was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Vesarian]]s|system=Vesari [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the
[[Vesarian]] social group<ref name="CN2">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> and shared its name with the [[Vesari fry-house]] [[Diet/Legends|dining]] establishment on<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Order66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vesari [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-10.<ref name="TEA" />
